title: GEDO: a method for product design generation and explainable design optimisation based on cross-modal alignment of text and images
scope_note: 全文逐页规则筛查＋高相关证据页语义清点；证据链仅保留PDF原句定位，未使用旧表内容。
context_summary: The paper proposes a method for product design generation and explainable design optimisation using cross-modal alignment of text and images. It introduces a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) for cross-modal feature alignment and uses Grad-CAM for model explainability. The method is evaluated on a dataset of text-image pairs collected from social media.
